name: Arms Dealer
summary:
Trade guns on a market that swings by the day and stay ahead of a loan shark whose debt grows daily. You've got 30 days to work the black market weapons trade and walk away rich or get buried under interest.

Prices swing daily, a pistol that's cheap this morning might be worth a fortune by the weekend.

Read the market, stockpile when it's low, dump when it spikes, and pray your timing holds.
